visual_elements.description: Feed-forward/backpropagation schematic inside a light rounded-rectangle container. Far left: three small filled purple dots in a vertical column. Black arrows point right into three hidden-layer summation nodes drawn as pale-green circles containing Σ. Each hidden Σ is followed by a small yellow activation square with a diagonal glyph, then a small white circle labeled lowercase 'o'. Blue upward arrows enter the hidden Σ nodes as biases. Arrows from the hidden 'o' circles point right into three output-layer Σ nodes. Above each output Σ is a small yellow square labeled 'Net' with a downward arrow into the Σ. To the right of each output Σ is a small circle labeled uppercase 'O', then a black arrow to 'Output1', 'Output2', and 'Outputm'. Blue upward bias arrows also enter the output Σ nodes. Black arrows from the outputs point right into a vertical red bar labeled 'Error' (the word appears repeated down the bar in the capture). Dotted curved arrows run from the output/error side back over the top of the output layer toward the hidden layer; two small yellow circular nodes sit in this dotted path and are unlabeled/illegible [?]. A bottom-left legend marker reads 'Node Bias'.

White panel with dark-red border, divided into three horizontal rows. Left column text: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'. Right column: the same stacked fraction ∂E over ∂w_ji with a red question mark on each row.
Yellow circular badge with black outline and black numeral '8'.
